items.title: Yemenis flee across Red Sea as Houthis and Saudi-backed forces escalate war
items.description: The BBC's Frank Gardner speaks to some of those who have fled the war by crossing the Red Sea to Djibouti.

items.title: CNN, MS NOW and Politico file lawsuit against Trump's White House ban
items.description: Major US networks later suspended White House TV coverage of Trump as he heads to New York for the UN summit.

items.title: Merz vows to keep coalition together for Germany's 'democratic future'
items.description: The chancellor has come under increasing pressure after resounding state election defeats, but says the results "go far beyond my own person"

items.title: First UK charges brought over 1994 Rwanda genocide
items.description: Dr Vincent Brown, formerly Dr Vincent Bajinya, 65, will appear at Westminster Magistrates’ Court on Tuesday charged with seven offences.

items.title: Millions urged to evacuate as powerful Typhoon Dujuan hits Japan
items.description: The country's meteorological agency had warned of an "imminent threat to life," but this has now been downgraded in most areas.

items.title: Russia's elections had few surprises - but how the Kremlin uses the results will be crucial
items.description: Vladimir Putin will likely use the result to claim most Russians back the so-called special military operation in Ukraine, writes the BBC's Steve Rosenberg.

items.title: Xhaka under investigation over Covid-19 certificate
items.description: Switzerland captain Granit Xhaka is being investigated over an issue with his Covid-19 vaccination certificate.
